focus: A verified staging update reduces interruption pressure: first-time consent and functional onboarding get priority, while returning visitors receive at most one automatic prompt per tab with repeat-prompt cooldowns. Production has not yet received this update because the existing identity verification gate is still pending.
nextStep: Let real reader traffic accumulate without lowering the five-page privacy threshold, while giving each future Desk edition its own deterministic visual-integrity receipt and recent-art diversity check.
